notes.title: Autumn Fest
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/93f0820197f443f6810ca963299b4dab0232aa6b.jpg"][/img]Autumn on the water — time for a big catch!
[/p][p]Friends, can you hear the crunch of leaves underfoot and feel the cool autumn breeze? At Fisher Online, the most picturesque time of year has arrived — and we're launching the autumn event "Autumn Fest"![/p][p]
From September 1 to September 8 (the event ends with a routine server restart at 1:00 AM UTD on September 9), you can look forward to:[/p][p]
- Exclusive autumn items — a special section of the store will feature unique rewards available only during the event.[/p][p]- A special atmosphere — enjoy autumn landscapes, refreshed water bodies, and a unique game mood.[/p][p]- New quests and challenges — fish, explore, and earn truly rare trophies.[/p][p]
In addition, this update brings:
[/p][p]- The headlamp is now a full-fledged item and can be equipped — a dedicated slot has been added to the inventory for this purpose. You can purchase a basic headlamp at any store in the "Accessories" category. New players will receive a headlamp by default.

- Repairing items with silver has been removed. Now items can only be repaired using repair kits.
[/p][p]- A new series of Wackys, Rapid MR, has been added to the store on certain locations.

Don't miss your chance to enrich your collection and experience the full charm of autumn in the game![/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/b57b1b16df289f430e248c7def24b22f51dee952.png[/img]

[b]Dear friends, [/b]
the Fisher Online team cordially wishes you a Happy New Year and Merry Christmas!

We are pleased to present you our new event
[h2] "Winter Fairy Tale"![/h2]

We have done what many people expect during the cold winter, when rivers and lakes are frozen. Now each player has a unique opportunity to try ice fishing and catch fish directly from the ice. To do this, you will need special winter gear, which can be purchased at the store on the location.

In addition, there is a Christmas tree on the location, which can be decorated with Christmas toys, which are given out for completing quests. And for those who complete the decoration of the Christmas tree, a gift will be waiting under the tree every day. Therefore, the one who decorates the Christmas tree earlier will receive more gifts.

To fully immerse yourself in the holiday atmosphere, New Year's skins for fishing chairs and a Christmas tree for the camp have been added to the game.

Don't forget to click on the Event button in the location to see the event description and other details. The event takes place at the Winter Fairy Tale location, accessible to all players. 

The event is scheduled to end on January 8 during a scheduled server reboot.


From the developer:
[i] The ice fishing mechanic appears in the game for the first time. Not everything was done as planned, so if anyone has any difficulties or mistakes, do not hesitate to ask for help.[/i]

notes.title: Atomic Week
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/e08e1ea7a658ced4d207effe9f2db6a5c5d77a34.png[/img]

Dear friends, it's the game's birthday and we announce 
[h2]Atomic Week![/h2]

During the event players will have access to “Atom: Wastelands”, where you will be able to show your talents in catching mutant fish that appeared in post-apocalyptic reservoirs.

For this event, a special currency has been added to the game - atomic tokens. They can be obtained both in quests and by making shipments of mutant meat, which are bought by the Merchant of the Southern Swamps.

From the event merchant, for atomic tokens, you can buy gear and items that are available nowhere else except in this event. The “atomic” tent is particularly noteworthy.

But it is not only fishing skills that you will need. There is also plenty to do on the shore and in the city. There you can find useful resources that will help with the event. Near the Southern Swamp Merchant there is a table for crafting unique event items.

If you don't have enough time to fully immerse yourself in the event activities or if you want to treat a friend, you can always visit the VIP store. Items purchased in the store can be transferred to other players.

The event will last until the scheduled server reboot on November 4 (Monday night)

[b]We invite you to take part in the New Year's event.[/b]

From today until January 7th (inclusive), the New Year's location "Rescue of Chelyuskin" is available. The location shows the most characteristic inhabitants of the Arctic Chukchi Sea.  The following activities are available to you:[list]

[/list]

The promotion will last until January 7th, inclusive of server time. 
Take part in the wintering and help the survivors with food.



[h2]Historical background[/h2]

[i] July 16, 1933 – the steamer Chelyuskin sailed from Leningrad to Murmansk under the command of the first captain Peteris Biezais and the head of the expedition O. Y. Schmidt.

On August 1, 1933, the steamer arrived in Murmansk. On August 2, 1933, the steamer sailed from Murmansk to Vladivostok.

On September 1, the steamer passed Cape Chelyuskin.

On September 23, the steamer was completely blocked in the ice of the Chukchi Sea. Chelyuskin has been drifting with the crew for almost 5 months.

On February 13, 1933, as a result of strong compression, Chelyuskin was crushed by ice and sank.
104 people from the ship's crew remained on the ice.

From March 5 to April 13, 1933, the pilots made 24 rescue flights and took out the entire crew of the Chelyuskin steamer.

During the forced wintering in the ice, not a single person died, moreover, one child was born in the ice.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.88

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/f9f9d8e26e8f585c60226415091f579ad4d77fe2.png[/img]

This update is mainly dedicated to the new mechanics of the game.

[u][b]Achievements[/b][/u]
Achievements are unlocked as hidden tasks are completed. As soon as you come across such a task, the achievement is considered open and you will be able to see a full description of what needs to be done to close the achievement. It is assumed that you will learn about hidden tasks as a result of communication with other players.  At the moment, there are only a little more than a dozen achievements, but I plan to increase their number with each update to at least a hundred.


[u][b]Collectible Card Albums[/b][/u]
The first album is received as a prize for the achievement of "Cardmaster". This album is green grade and holds only 20 cards. With the help of improvements, you can bring your album to the orange grade and increase the capacity at times. To put the card in the album, you need to drag it in the inventory to the picture of the album, to get it, you need to open the album and drag it outside the container

[i]The mechanics of albums is a new mechanics of storing items "in a container" and, probably, it will develop further, in the form of separate boxes for baits or installed boxes in the house.[/i] 

[b][u]Insect traps and composters[/u][/b]
Items of this class can be obtained for completing the "worms" or "insects" achievements.
This is an item that is installed on the ground, which has a set of its own recipes and works on the principle of "crafting over time".  The result of crafting does not depend on the location of the trap, the main thing is that the location is not winter.

[u][b]Trap for crayfish[/b][/u]
This is a separate class of trap, the final result of which will depend on the installation location. If, for example, you chose to catch crayfish, and there are no crayfish in the place where you set the trap, then there will be no crayfish in the final result, or, conversely, there may be an increased number of them if there are a lot of crayfish in this place.


Except for it to these prizes, there are other new lures and recipes in the achievements.

In addition to these important things, the update includes the following changes:

Added hidden parameters "endurance" and "endurance regeneration". Each level of the player increases the basic endurance.  Fatigue accumulates during a long run.  
Fatigue regeneration (rest) occurs when standing still or sitting on a chair. 
The "satiety" buff from food and drinks increases rest depending on the grade of food and drinks. 
Fatigue DOES NOT AFFECT the fishing of fish

Some baits (insects) - increase in value

Crayfish, mollusk, leech - a significant decrease in the activity of biting on conventional baits, also, these species are excluded from the need to catch their trophy specimens to receive a silver medal. But it is still possible to catch them with ordinary gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/68eeec26c70dfd09452195a7da9bd218fe5cd5f7.png[/img]

Hello, friends. That's the end of the New Year's events. But while you were giving and receiving gifts from the Christmas tree, we also did not sit idle.

This time I decided to go for a curious experiment and include in the game a fishing base created by the player, namely fortunecafe from the EPF club. Initially, he created one of the ponds of the Katlov pond system, but since these fishing ponds, firstly, are too large, and secondly, this name is a protected trade mark, it was decided to create some imaginary Czech location. And that's what we got:

[h2]Czech Republic: Rybavica Pond[/h2]

This is a fairly small private commercial pond, with artificial fish settlement. The pond is regularly cleaned and the fish are fed in it, so it is replete with large trophies. The main direction is the traditional Czech carp fishing. In addition, some other exotic species are also inhabited in the lake, such as the American white sturgeon (also named Lake sturgeon -  which does not reach trophy sizes here) or the Chinese koi carp. Separately, I would like to note the presence of two species of catfish, which 30-40 years ago in the Czech Republic were actively settled in lakes and rivers, 300 individuals per year and even more, which, as a result, led to the fact that catfish ate almost all white fish, and you will not find bleak or bream here. Of the endemics, only those species survived that were able to get into the dense coastal grass to escape from catfish - crucian carp, rudd, gaster and, of course, roach. However, catfish in this reservoir rarely reach trophy sizes. 

The pond is accessible from the 15th level and in the sense of the game is transitional between carp Germany to carp France.

[b]Rules of the card game: [/b]

In the process of catching fish, either empty cards or white cards fall out. The white card can be cleared by getting an empty card. Having collected a collection of three empty cards, you can get a booster card in a package, opening which, you can get a white or green card with a high probability,

notes.title: Update 49
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/94804a0c5c11db3b51cc651ca46bd6b2c5a5aedd.jpg[/img]

Hello, friends. For a long time, players complained about too strong fish, so a lot of work was done in this direction. Now the game has such a parameter as "fish control", which increases with increasing the level of ownership of the fishing rod.  It is implied that by increasing the skill of the fishing rod, the player has better control of the fish, smooths its jerks and turns it better in the direction of himself. Also, this parameter accelerates the fatigue of the fish. Also, now other previously hidden parameters of pumping the rod are show, for example, such as the accuracy of casting or increasing the range. 

The updated mechanics work best when fishing standing up, in this case, the power of lifting the fish and its control is increased. You can stand both on the shore and on the boat.  In addition, the behavior of large fish has also been changed, it gets tired faster, and in general, it now does not like to do this.

In addition to the updated mechanics of fishing, the game added the method of Asian fishing "herabuna".  This is a light float fly rod, specially designed for fishing "from the bottom" on soft dough. All new rods are available for sale in the store at all locations (except Dukora Pond) and have an experience bonus, i.e. they are a kind of ultralight stick rods. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/0bfed38983c91c475c968af7f575a949630cd45a.jpg[/img]

Also, a series of lines, called StickLines with a length of 50 meters and a strength of 2 to 25 kg, was delivered to all stores. 


In addition, the update fixes the following errors::

[list]
[*] stuck the rod in the hand with the inability to drop it
[*] stuck the rod with a quick change of rods
[*] shaking the fish when lifting
[/list]

notes.title: Update 30.6
notes.content:
Dynamic experience for catching fish added

If you open the "Fish in the lake" tab, you can see the scale of your catch of this fish in this reservoir.
With a green scale of 0-100%, you get a bonus to experience up to 25% when you catch this fish
With a yellow scale of 100-300%, you do not gain additional experience
When the red scale is> 300%, experience begins to decrease when catching this fish [b] in this reservoir [/b].

If you stop catching this type of fish in this reservoir, then within a month the scale will decrease to 0% and you can again receive bonus experience.
Please note that the scale refers to the type of fish in this reservoir only. If the fish lives in another body of water, there will be a separate scale for it

notes.title: New fish freeze system
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/893f884c2b70034f40f85ca50ff013adbc2bf0e4.jpg[/img]

Hello friends. I present to you a new experimental system for freezing fish.
Large ships (Finland, the Danube, the Caspian) have freezers, opening which you can put fish from your cage in them. The fish becomes frozen. To sell frozen fish, you need to bring the vessel to any of the points of sale of frozen fish that look like a crane with blue boxes, stop the vessel (it is better to anchor) and press the R button when a message appears. Please note that freezers do not have restrictions on the weight of fish, and only on the number. Thus, you can place at 100 kilogram fishes in them, thereby freeing your cage for further fishing without entering the point of sale. Please note that prices for frozen fish are dynamic and may differ from prices for fresh fish.

This mechanic opens the way to large marine locations and new ways of catching sea fish.

notes.title: Fishing clubs and floatfishing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/6af480918fde82e080039686dd5be0e3f0fa38c5.jpg[/img]

Hi friends. There are two important innovations in today's update.

[b]First [/b]:
This is a completely updated float mechanics. The mechanics of casting, the behavior of the float in water and bite were refactoring. Each type of fish got its recognizable bite, and fishing rods got its positioning when fishing. So, stickrods are perfect for quickly catching small fish for bait, bologna rod for comfortable catching medium fish in still water and stream, and matchrods for long casting when catching large carp using wagglers.

[b]Second: [/b]
Added the ability to create your own fishing club. This mechanics is only at the beginning of its path and still has little functionality. What does the club give? A common chat tag for all club members, their own club chat, online tracking of club members and a system of "officers" with different rights. At the moment, the club can accept only 10 people.
What is planned to be added in subsequent updates on this mechanic is club tasks that are performed by all club members, receiving club experience for this. Club levels, increasing which you can get club skill points and use them either to expand the number of club members, or to increase the number of officers, or other club skills.
In the future planned the visibility of club members at locations, club tournaments, and even a club house and ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35322211/d225dd8c061b1bd713520236e8d73652868a7a06.png[/img]  But you can start your best club now. To do this, you need to have a 10th level and 15 thousand silver, in any store you can buy the "Club Foundator Sign" and, using it, create your own club. If you don’t want to spend silver, or your level is less, you can simply buy this token for real money on the VIP sale page in the game.
